sentence: Find customers who recharged after the promo was sent to them.
clarification: When you say "recharged after the promo was sent," do you mean any recharge at any point after the promo was sent (temporal ordering), or recharges within a specific number of days after the promo (e.g., within 7 or 30 days)?

sentence: Find customers who recharged within 7 days of the promo being sent.
clarification: Are you asking for customers who recharged within 7 days of a specific promo date you'll supply at runtime, or within 7 days of when any promotion was sent to them?

sentence: Find customers who got a promotion delivered in the last X days.
expected_parent_condition: L_PROMO_SENT_DATE >= CurrentTime-${X}DAYS AND LC_ACTION_TYPE IN LIST (Promotion;PROMOTION;promotion) AND L_ACTION_KEY ${operator} ${value} AND COUNT_ALL(L_AGG_MSISDN) > 0
returned_parent_condition: L_PROMO_SENT_DATE >= CurrentTime-${X}DAYS AND LC_ACTION_TYPE IN LIST (Promotion;PROMOTION;promotion) AND COUNT_ALL(L_AGG_MSISDN) > 0

sentence: Find customers who were not delivered a promotion in the last 180 days.
expected_parent_condition: L_PROMO_SENT_DATE >= CurrentTime-180DAYS AND LC_ACTION_TYPE IN LIST (Promotion;PROMOTION;promotion) AND L_ACTION_KEY ${operator} ${value} AND COUNT_ALL(L_AGG_MSISDN) = 0
returned_parent_condition: L_SENT_DATE >= CurrentTime-180DAYS AND LC_ACTION_TYPE IN LIST (Promotion;PROMOTION;promotion) AND COUNT_ALL(L_AGG_MSISDN) = 0

sentence: Find customers who received fewer than a specified number of bonuses in a specified number of days.
expected_parent_condition: L_BONUS_SENT_DATE >= CurrentTime-${NoOfDays}DAYS AND L_BONUS_ACTION_KEY ${operator} ${value} AND COUNT_ALL(L_AGG_MSISDN) < ${NoOfBonus}
returned_parent_condition: L_BONUS_SENT_DATE >= CurrentTime-${X}DAYS AND LC_ACTION_TYPE IN LIST (BONUS;Bonus;bonus) AND COUNT_ALL(L_AGG_MSISDN) ${operator} ${value}
